capabilities.name: PACED_MOVEMENT_V1
capabilities.owner_decision: CONDITIONS-0 §4.3 (docs/architecture/reviews/OTERYN_GAME_CONDITIONS0_ACTOR_CONDITIONS_DECISION_2026-09-30.md, as amended by CREATURE-AI-0 §5.1); number allocated by the #1622 control plane and registered by SPEED-1
capabilities.offer_gate: SPEED-1: offered. It extends the result of command type 1 with STEP_DISPOSITION_TOO_EARLY = 4 and owns no command type or domain. Every player step is paced whether or not it is selected: one early step waits in a one-step buffer, and a second early request is TOO_EARLY with this capability selected and REJECTED without it.

Without it selected, domain 14 is never sent, command type 21 is refused as unsupported, the CONTAINER destination of command type 9 (field 5) fails closed and USE field 2 on a container handle keeps its capability 4 meaning.
